date: 2026-08-24

  echo: true
  warning: false

---

The public analysis starts from six pseudonymized Parquet files in
`data/private/`. This stage checks that those files match the tracked schemas
and the fixed data-lock manifest. Raw REDCap exports are never read here.

```{r}
#| label: validate-inputs

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
data_lock <- config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock")
private_dir <- here::here(config_get(config, "paths", "private_data"))
schema_dir <- here::here(config_get(config, "paths", "schema_dir"))
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
validation_path <- file.path(result_dir, "input-validation.parquet")

domains <- c(
  "recruitment",
  "cohort_follow_up",
  "qol",
  "taooh",
  "ctdna_samples",
  "alterations"
)

manifest_path <- file.path(private_dir, "manifest.yml")
if (!file.exists(manifest_path)) {
  stop("Missing data/private/manifest.yml. Build the private analysis datasets first.")
}

manifest <- read_data_manifest(manifest_path)
validate_data_manifest(manifest, expected_lock = data_lock, private_dir = private_dir)

expected_files <- paste0(domains, ".parquet")
observed_files <- list.files(private_dir, pattern = "\\.parquet$", ignore.case = TRUE)
if (!setequal(observed_files, expected_files)) {
  stop(
    "data/private must contain exactly: ", paste(expected_files, collapse = ", "),
    ". Found: ", paste(observed_files, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!setequal(names(manifest$domains), domains)) {
  stop("manifest.yml must describe exactly the six public analysis datasets.")
}

validation_rows <- vector("list", length(domains))
for (index in seq_along(domains)) {
  domain <- domains[[index]]
  data_path <- file.path(private_dir, paste0(domain, ".parquet"))
  schema_path <- file.path(schema_dir, paste0(domain, ".yml"))
  manifest_record <- manifest$domains[[domain]]

  if (!isTRUE(manifest_record$available)) {
    stop("The manifest marks ", domain, " as unavailable.")
  }
  if (!identical(as.character(manifest_record$file), basename(data_path))) {
    stop("The manifest filename for ", domain, " does not match the public contract.")
  }

  schema <- read_data_schema(schema_path)
  data <- arrow::read_parquet(data_path) |>
    as.data.frame()
  required_columns <- names(schema_columns(schema))[vapply(
    schema_columns(schema),
    function(column) isTRUE(column$required),
    logical(1)
  )]
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(data))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(domain, " is missing: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (identical(domain, "cohort_follow_up")) {
    if ("site_id" %in% names(data)) {
      stop("cohort_follow_up still contains site_id. Rebuild the private data with setting_id.")
    }
    if ("eligible" %in% names(data) && !is.character(data$eligible)) {
      stop("cohort_follow_up$eligible must be the REDCap string field.")
    }
  }
  if (identical(domain, "recruitment")) {
    validate_data_schema(data, schema)
    if (any(!is.na(data$group_assignment) & !data$group_assignment %in% 0:1)) {
      stop("Recruitment group_assignment must be 0/1 or missing.")
    }
  }
  if (identical(domain, "cohort_follow_up")) {
    validate_blood_product_counts(data)
  }
  key <- as.character(schema$primary_key)
  if (length(key) > 0L &&
      (any(!stats::complete.cases(data[key])) || anyDuplicated(data[key]))) {
    stop(domain, " has a missing or duplicated primary key.")
  }
  assert_no_phi_columns(data)
  validation_rows[[index]] <- data.frame(
    domain = domain,
    file = basename(data_path),
    n_rows = nrow(data),
    status = "validated",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

source(here::here("R", "taooh-helpers.R"))
validate_taooh_follow_up(
  arrow::read_parquet(file.path(private_dir, "taooh.parquet")),
  arrow::read_parquet(file.path(private_dir, "cohort_follow_up.parquet"))
)
qol <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(private_dir, "qol.parquet"))
if (any(qol$day > config$analysis$horizon_days, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  stop("QoL export extends beyond 182 days.")
}

validation_summary <- do.call(rbind, validation_rows)
rownames(validation_summary) <- NULL
arrow::write_parquet(validation_summary, validation_path)
```

```{r}
#| label: validation-status
#| tbl-cap: "Validated analysis inputs"
#| echo: false

validation_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
